sources.title: DeepSeek-V4: How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: The lossless 8-bit GGUF is 162 GB and 3-bit is 103GB which can run on a 110GB RAM device. DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 scores 82.7% on Terminal Bench 2.1, 54.4% on DeepSWE, and 54.2% on NL2Repo. DSpark is also enabled for GGUFs, enabling up to 2x faster decoding speed! DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 was released as of Aug 13 2026 today. Quants are in progress.
